added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: the assertion _entry_signature(real) == before cannot fail, because _run_sync monkeypatches Path.home to a temporary home, so a regressed sync (the declared mutation) writes the link under that temporary home and never under the operator's real ~/.claude/skills the assertion reads; it thus guards nothing while making the test read state outside the repository, which can flake if a concurrent live session repoints that entry mid-test.

follow-on: doctor's Skills-presence check still resolves Path.home()/".claude"/"skills" instead of _personal_skills_dir(), so the autouse fixture tests/conftest.py:1071 does not isolate it; a future doctor test that relies on the fixture rather than patching Path.home would read the operator's real skills directory, which is the goal this node states and the done-when names only for the link check.

item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit 9bdf6250a against base 6ab102dd1; it adds _personal_skills_dir and CLAUDE_SKILLS_DIR_ENV, routes _sync_crew_host_plugin (cli.py:267) and the doctor link check (cli.py:8193) through it, adds the autouse fixture tests/conftest.py:1071, and adds tests/test_doctor_session_host_link.py:397.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_doctor_session_host_link.py and the negative control; the manifest records 17 passed EXIT=0 and a mutation log ending EXIT=1, and I re-ran the gate at head 9bdf6250a independently as 17 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to keep every test's reckon sync and doctor away from the real ~/.claude/skills; reckon/cli.py:152 _personal_skills_dir resolves it from RECKON_CLAUDE_SKILLS_DIR and reckon/cli.py:267 (_sync_crew_host_plugin) and reckon/cli.py:8193 (doctor link check) now route through it, so both named sites stop reaching the operator's real directory.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the gate result, names the negative-control log whose last line is EXIT=1, records the sole failing id test_sync_leaves_the_real_skills_directory_untouched, and carries a follow-on for reckon-install-skills at reckon/cli.py:8651.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the declared scope (reckon/cli.py, tests/conftest.py, tests/test_doctor_session_host_link.py, the evidence fragment, the figures dir); every path in the diff is inside it and the unused figures directory was not created, which the contract permits.

justifications.durability: the guard at tests/test_doctor_session_host_link.py:420 genuinely fails under the declared mutation, but the companion assertion at :422 (_entry_signature(real) == before) is inert because _run_sync monkeypatches Path.home, so the code under test cannot reach the real entry the assertion claims to protect.
justifications.evidence: I re-ran the node's own gate tests/test_doctor_session_host_link.py at head 9bdf6250a (log review-head-gate.log) as 17 passed EXIT=0, and the manifest's negative-control log reproduces 1 failed, 16 passed, EXIT=1 at tests/test_doctor_session_host_link.py:420, the id the manifest names.
justifications.fit: the added names (_personal_skills_dir, CLAUDE_SKILLS_DIR_ENV, isolated_claude_skills_dir) describe mechanism with no version, plan or ticket identifier and no attribution, matching reckon/cli.py:141-162 idiom, but tests/conftest.py:1063 re-spells the env-var name as its own literal instead of importing reckon/cli.py:149's constant, so a rename there would silently stop the fixture isolating tests.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/cli.py:152 and its two named call sites deliver the done-when, but reckon/cli.py:8176 keeps the doctor Skills-presence check on Path.home()/".claude"/"skills" and ignores the override, so the goal's "every test's doctor" holds only because the sibling tests/test_doctor.py:94 patches Path.home, not because the new fixture isolates it.
justifications.reuse: a search of reckon/*.py for ".claude/skills" found no existing resolver for the personal skills directory (reckon/serve.py:333 resolves the unrelated html-docs asset path), so _personal_skills_dir at reckon/cli.py:152 extends no owner and forks none.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 6ab102dd1..9bdf6250a touches exactly the four declared paths (reckon/cli.py, tests/conftest.py, tests/test_doctor_session_host_link.py, the evidence fragment) and nothing else; the declared figures directory is unused as the done-when names no artifact.
